title: FedVP: Federated Learning across Heterogeneous Models by Pooling Locally Trained Verifiers
abstract: arXiv:2611.13708v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Conventional federated learning relies on the shared model backbone to aggregate client updates, limiting collaboration among institutions that deploy large language models (LLMs) from different families and at different scales. We propose Federated Verifier Pool (FEDVP), a new federated learning paradigm that enables heterogeneous clients to collaborate through shared verification rather than parameter aggregation. Each client trains a verifier using local data and responses generated by its chosen LLM backbone. The server pools these independently trained verifiers and combines their judgments to select answers without merging model parameters. This allows both LLM backbones and verifiers to differ in architecture and size, while keeping the LLM backbones frozen and deriving collaborative gains from improved answer selection. We evaluate FEDVP across five public medical question-answering datasets treated as federated clients, using Qw

translated_title: FedVP：通过汇聚本地训练的验证器实现跨异构模型的联邦学习
translated_abstract: 传统的联邦学习依赖于共享的模型骨干来聚合客户端更新，这限制了部署不同家族、不同规模大语言模型（LLM）的机构之间的协作。我们提出联邦验证器池，这是一种新的联邦学习范式，使异构客户端能够通过共享验证而非参数聚合来进行协作。每个客户端使用本地数据及其所选LLM骨干生成的回复来训练一个验证器；服务器将这些独立训练的验证器汇集起来，结合它们的判断来选择答案，而无需合并模型参数。这使得LLM骨干和验证器都可以在架构和规模上各不相同，同时保持LLM骨干冻结，并通过改进的答案选择来获得协作收益。我们在五个公开的医疗问答数据集（作为联邦客户端）上对FedVP进行了评估，使用Qw（摘要在此处截断，信息不完整）
tldr: 该论文提出FedVP新范式，让使用不同（冻结的）大语言模型骨干的异构客户端通过共享、汇聚各自本地训练的验证器来协作选择答案，从而在不聚合或修改模型参数的情况下实现联邦学习收益。
en_tdlr: FedVP is a new federated learning paradigm that enables heterogeneous clients with different frozen LLM backbones to collaborate by pooling locally trained verifiers for improved answer selection, rather than aggregating model parameters.
